newsitem.title: FRANCE: Elf signs Trinidad production share deal.
newsitem.headline: Elf signs Trinidad production share deal.

text.p: French oil company Elf Aquitaine said on Thursday its Elf Exploration Trinidad BV unit along with joint venture partners Amoco Trinidad and Repsol Exploracion Trinidad SA had signed a production-sharing deal with the government of Trinidad and Tobago.
The contract involves offshore Block S11 (b) comprising some 400 square km off Trinidad's south coast.
Elf Exploration Trinidad BV is the operator of the block with a 40 percent stake. Amoco also has a 40 percent interest while Repsol has a 20 percent holding.
Plans for the first three-year exploration phase call for a 3D seismic survey of 250 square km and the drilling of one exploratory well.
The acquisition is part of Elf's exploration strategy in the Latin American region aimed at positioning itself in basins with significant hydrocarbon potential.
Elf is already a partner with a 30 percent interest in offshore Block 2(c) in Trinidad and Tobago.
Elf is also developing exploration and production activities in Ecuador, Venezuela, Bolivia and Peru.
